title: TileMix: Tile-Centric Mixed-Precision Attention for LLM Inference Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2608.17336v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context prefill in large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory traffic because dense self-attention computes quadratic query-key scores. Existing methods either use a uniform low-precision path or select token interactions, leaving spatial precision routing over hardware-aligned score tiles outside fused dense attention. We introduce TileMix, a tile-centric precision-routing kernel that makes numerical precision an executable spatial decision over score-tile groups within fused dense attention. TileMix partitions the attention matrix into hardware-aligned score tiles, packs routing decisions into compact bitmasks, and dispatches each tile group through FP16 or INT8 score computation while both paths update a shared online-softmax state. Scalable precision grouping lets each routing bit govern multiple adjacent key tiles, preserving hardware-aligned compute tiles and compact metadata at long contexts. By ro

translated_title: TileMix：面向LLM推理加速的以瓦片为中心的混合精度注意力机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的长上下文预填充阶段会引发大量计算和内存流量，因为密集自注意力机制需要计算二次方规模的查询-键分数。现有方法要么采用统一的低精度路径，要么选择性地处理令牌交互，但在融合的密集注意力中，未能将空间精度路由应用于硬件对齐的分数瓦片。我们引入了TileMix，一种以瓦片为中心的精度路由内核，它将数值精度转化为融合密集注意力中分数瓦片组上的可执行空间决策。TileMix将注意力矩阵划分为硬件对齐的分数瓦片，将路由决策压缩为紧凑的位掩码，并通过FP16或INT8分数计算路径调度每个瓦片组，同时两条路径共享一个在线softmax状态。可扩展的精度分组使每个路由位能够控制多个相邻键瓦片，从而在长上下文场景中保持硬件对齐的计算瓦片和紧凑的元数据。
tldr: TileMix通过将注意力矩阵划分为硬件对齐的分数瓦片，并用位掩码实现空间精度路由（FP16/INT8混合），在融合密集注意力中大幅加速LLM推理。
en_tdlr: TileMix accelerates LLM inference by partitioning the attention matrix into hardware-aligned score tiles and using bitmask-based spatial precision routing (FP16/INT8 hybrid) within fused dense attention.
